t: An Edo kingdom in southern Nigeria whose Obas built a regional empire from Benin City from the 15th century.
Royal guilds produced the Benin Bronzes, among the finest figurative sculpture of sub-Saharan Africa.
A British expedition burned Benin City in 1897 and looted its art, now at the centre of the restitution debate.
dyk: Much of the metal for the Benin Bronzes came from Portuguese brass manillas, horseshoe-shaped bracelets used as currency in trade.
ev: Eweka I founds the Oba dynasty after the Ogiso line loses legitimacy
Ewuare the Great seizes the throne, rebuilds Benin City and begins expansion
Portuguese traders under João Afonso de Aveiro reach Benin
Oba Esigie defeats a major Igala invasion from the north
Death of Ehengbuda, the last of Benin's warrior kings
Civil war under Oba Ewuakpe brings the monarchy close to abolition
British Punitive Expedition burns Benin City and exiles Oba Ovonramwen
